svg.aria-label: Replicate a store, on disk. An empty replica pulls a store of 1,000 records, in process, through the library's own sync protocol, until every record reads back. Each library's own persistence on node:fs, every write awaited. records/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: syncom (the pure build: only its text is typed through openText()); Yjs (memory only — on disk the Yjs row stores every update already); Loro (memory only — on disk the Loro row appends every update already); RxDB (Node.js disk storages are Premium); Fireproof (syncs through a cloud or self-hosted gateway only); GUN (syncs over its WebSocket/WebRTC mesh only).
